The system integrates two independent sources of fair value estimation: Kalshi's market-derived estimates and Poisson-distributed team rate models. These are combined into a unified context field within the scoring engine. The CLV (Calibrated Loss Value) dashboard provides feedback loops that validate these estimates against real-world outcomes. A deliberate model version bump allows for controlled deployment of improved edge pricing. This architecture ensures that each component operates under well-defined assumptions and failure regimes while maintaining a coherent probabilistic structure across layers. Dualities emerge in how both estimators contribute to confidence adjustment, and their convergence validates the integrity of the overall inference chain.
